RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r1.claim: This is the third form of warning to unbelievers: recalling the blessing of their creation makes their ingratitude more heinous and the resulting punishment greater.
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r1.anchor: اعلم أن هذا هو النوع الثالث : من تخويف الكفار ووجه التخويف فيه من وجهين : الأول : أنه تعالى ذكرهم عظيم إنعامه عليهم ، وكلما كانت نعمة الله عليهم أكثر كانت جنايتهم في حقه أقبح وأفحش

RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r2.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r2.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r2.claim: A second warning is that the One able to originate creation is evidently able to resurrect; rejecting this proof warrants the threat of woe.
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r2.anchor: الوجه الثاني : أنه تعالى ذكرهم كونه قادرا على الابتداء ، وظاهر في العقل أن القادر على الابتداء قادر على الإعادة

RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r3.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r3.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r3.claim: Māʾ mahīn means the sperm drop, as in the verse describing offspring from a humble fluid.
RAZI-FULL:v30p239#2/r3.anchor: وأما التفسير فهو أن قوله : { ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين } أي من النطفة ، كقوله : { ثم جعل نسله من سلالة من ماء مهين

STUDYQURAN:77:20/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r1.claim: Human creation from a base fluid recalls humble origins and testifies to God's creative power and ability to resurrect people.
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r1.anchor: The creation of the human being from a base fluid (cf. 32:8) is cited in several verses to remind people of their humble origins

STUDYQURAN:77:20/r4.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r4.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r4.claim: Those who fail to recognize their own creation deny God and become manifest adversaries to God and themselves.
STUDYQURAN:77:20/r4.anchor: those who do not recognize the nature of their own creation deny God and are thus a manifest adversary (16:4; 36:77)

TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r1.claim: Māʾ mahīn means weak semen; Ibn ʿAbbās also glosses mahīn as weak.
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس، قوله: {ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين} [المرسلات: 20] يعني بالمهين: الضعيف

TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r2.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r2.speaker: ابن عباس
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r2.claim: Ibn ʿAbbās glosses mahīn as weak.
TAB-FULL:v23p594#3/r2.anchor: عن ابن عباس، قوله: {ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين} [المرسلات: 20] يعني بالمهين: الضعيف

TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.claim: This passage presents proofs of God's sole lordship and the Day of Decision, recalls punishment for deniers and blessings for the pious, and reproaches those arrogant toward worship and revelation.
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r1.anchor: بيان حجج دالة على توحد الربوبية تقضي بوجود يوم الفصل الذي فيه جزاء المكذبين به

TABATABAI:77:16-24/r7.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r7.speaker: author
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r7.claim: The contemptible, low-value, minimally useful water is the semen.
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r7.anchor: والماء المهين الحقير قليل الغناء والمراد به النطفة

TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.speaker: author
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.claim: Creation and the governance of human development prove sole lordship; lordship entails the creatures' submission and obligation, which requires recompense on a Day of Decision.
TABATABAI:77:16-24/r12.anchor: الربوبية تستوجب خضوع المربوبين لساحتها وهو الدين المتضمن للتكليف

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r9.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:77:10-24/r9.anchor: { ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين } أي: النطفة.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.claim: The “despised water” is sperm, the “secure place” is the womb, and the “known term” is the period of pregnancy.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r1.anchor: “Önemsenmeyen bir su”dan maksat sperm (bk. Kıyâmet 75/37), onun yerleştirildiği “sağlam yer” ana rahmi, “belli bir süre” ise hamilelik dönemidir.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.claim: Human origins and development provide a striking example of God’s creative power and show the baselessness of denying resurrection.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r2.anchor: Âyetlerde insanın hangi maddeden ve nasıl yaratıldığı açıklanarak Allah’ın neleri yapmaya, yaratmaya kadir olduğuna dair en dikkate değer örneklerden biri ortaya konmuş

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.claim: God formed humans from simple semen, developed them through stages in the womb, endowed them with material and spiritual abilities, and made them Earth’s most perfect beings.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r4.anchor: Allah insanı basit, bir sudan yani meniden yaratmış, ana rahminde onu çeşitli aşamalardan geçirerek

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.claim: Despite these priceless gifts, humanity is ungrateful and disobeys God; the surah has warned since verse 18, “Woe on that day to the deniers.”
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r5.anchor: Ama insanoğlu nankörlük ederek kendisine paha biçilmez nimetleri lutfeden Allah’a isyan etmektedir. İşte bundan dolayı 18.âyetten başlamak üzere

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.claim: The one who created a perfect human from simple water is also able to resurrect that human after death.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:77:20/r6.anchor: Basit bir sudan böyle mükemmel insanı yaratıp meydana getiren yaratıcı kudret onu öldükten sonra diriltmeye de kadirdir.

QUSHAYRI:v3p380/r19.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p380/r19.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p380/r19.claim: The contemptible origin of human beings should lead them to infer resurrection from their first creation.
QUSHAYRI:v3p380/r19.anchor: وإذ قد علمتم ذلك فلم لم تقيسوا أمر البعث عليه

QUSHAYRI:v3p380/r20.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p380/r20.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p380/r20.claim: Reminding humans of their humble origin restrains conceit about their states, since no creatures claim more than Adam's descendants.
QUSHAYRI:v3p380/r20.anchor: ذكرهم أصل خلقتم لئلا يعجبوا بأحوالهم ؛ فإنه لا جنس من المخلوقين والمخلوقات أشد دعوى من بني آدم

DAMGHANI:v1p477/r8.author: al-Dāmghānī
DAMGHANI:v1p477/r8.speaker: author
DAMGHANI:v1p477/r8.claim: Mahīn can mean weak or lowly.
DAMGHANI:v1p477/r8.anchor: ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين أي ضعيف

IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p638/r5.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p638/r5.speaker: أهل التفسير
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p638/r5.claim: Mahīn can mean weak or lowly, describing the fluid from which humans are created.
IBNJAWZI-NUZHA:v1p638/r5.anchor: والرابع : الضعف . ومنه قوله تعالى في المرسلات

NAHHAS:v5p115/r14.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p115/r14.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p115/r14.claim: Assimilation of qaf into kaf is permitted in the phrase.

NAHHAS:v5p115/r15.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p115/r15.speaker: ابن عباس
NAHHAS:v5p115/r15.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses مهين as weak.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r1.claim: After the oath, al-Mursalat opens with the first scenes of Judgment, then turns to remind people of creation and the blessing of their origin.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r1.anchor: بدأت بعد القسم (وَالْمُرْسَلَاتِ عُرْفًا (1) بذكر المشهد الأول من أحداث يوم القيامة

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r2.claim: The surah then follows a natural sequence by describing the fate of deniers before the reward of the pious.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r2.anchor: ثم عاد إلى ذكر الجزاء حسب التسلسل جزاء المكذبين ثم جزاء المتقين وهذا تسلسل طبيعي

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r4.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r4.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r4.claim: The surah's structure alternates Judgment scenes, reminders to people, the two outcomes, and a final reminder so they may take heed.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p853/r4.anchor: إذن المنهج الذي سار عليه في السورة هو ذكر أحداث يوم القيامة ثم تذكير الناس ثم ذكر الجزاء ثم تذكير الناس حتى يتّعظوا

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.claim: Human physical structure and stages of creation display God's power, providence, and wisdom; the Creator can readily recreate people, so resurrection is certain and its deniers doomed.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p109/r1.anchor: The purpose of this mention is that man’s own creation bears testimony that re-creating him is not at all difficult for His Creator.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.claim: After historical evidence, the passage turns to man's creation as evidence for resurrection and the Day of Judgement.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r4.anchor: The previous verses presented historical evidence. These verses present evidence drawn from the creation of man.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.claim: The Qur'an argues that judgement is possible because humans were created from fluid, required by God's power, wisdom, and creativity, entailed by the provision system, and supported by innate awareness of good and evil.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r5.anchor: from the creation of man in various ways

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.claim: The initial creation of man from mud and a drop of fluid proves that resurrection is possible.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r6.anchor: By referring to man’s creation from mud and from a drop of fluid, evidence is drawn on the fact that the Day of Judgement is a possible phenomenon.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.claim: The signs of God's power, wisdom, and creativity in making man entail that the Day of Judgement must come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r7.anchor: The signs of God’s power, wisdom and creativity in the creation of man entail that a Day of Judgement must come.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.claim: The elaborate system established to sustain man also entails that a Day of Judgement must come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r8.anchor: The tremendous system for man’s sustenance elaborately set up by the Almighty also entails that a Day of Judgement must come.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.claim: Man's innate awareness of good and evil is further evidence that a Day of Judgement must come.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p120/r9.anchor: The innate awareness about good and evil found in a person bears evidence that a Day of Judgement must come.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.claim: The initial creation of man from an insignificant fluid answers deniers who wonder how God could recreate people after their bones decay; what is already evident makes resurrection possible.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r1.anchor: when no one can deny such an obvious reality as man being created from an insignificant fluid

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r2.claim: Mahīn means insignificant and frivolous; man comes from a trivial, ordinary fluid abundant in nature, so recreating him is not difficult.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r2.anchor: He is created from a trivial and ordinary thing found in abundance in nature.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p121/r3.claim: Calling the fluid insignificant also highlights that the God who created a human from it has the power to recreate him.

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.claim: The preceding argument invokes signs within human beings and in the external world; the ensuing passage makes the unseen punishment vivid to the deniers.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p125/r1.anchor: through the signs found in the world inside man and those found outside him.

NASHR:v2p19/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p19/r1.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p19/r1.claim: When a quiescent first letter meets an identical or homorganic second letter, recitation and Arabic require assimilation, except when the first is a long vowel or a guttural; the text gives examples of both classes.
NASHR:v2p19/r1.anchor: كل حرفين التقيا أولهما ساكن وكانا مثلين أو جنسين وجب إدغام الأول منهما لغة وقراءة

NASHR:v2p19/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p19/r2.speaker: الهذلي
NASHR:v2p19/r2.claim: Al-Hudhali uniquely transmits iẓhār from Ibn Dhakwān through Ibn al-Akhram, and a similar report is attributed to Qālūn; pure unassimilated iẓhār is impermissible.
NASHR:v2p19/r2.anchor: انفرد الهذلي عن أبي الفضل الرازي من طريق ابن الأخرم عن ابن ذكوان بإظهاره، وكذلك حكي عن أحمد عن قالون

NASHR:v2p19/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p19/r3.speaker: الداني
NASHR:v2p19/r3.claim: Al-Dānī says there is consensus to assimilate qāf into kāf as a pure kāf with no retained sound, and calls the reported Qālūn iẓhār erroneous in transmission and Arabic.
NASHR:v2p19/r3.anchor: أجمعوا على إدغام القاف في الكاف وقلبها كافا خالصة من غير إظهار صوت لها

NASHR:v2p19/r4.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p19/r4.speaker: ابن مهران
NASHR:v2p19/r4.claim: Ibn Mujāhid says only Abū ʿAmr assimilates it; Ibn Mihrān calls this mistaken, citing Ibn Shanabūdh's consensus report and al-Hāshimī's prohibition of iẓhār.
NASHR:v2p19/r4.anchor: وقال ابن مجاهد في مسائل رفعت إليه فأجاب فيها لا يدغمه إلا أبو عمرو قال ابن مهران وهذا منه غلط كبير

NASHR:v2p19/r5.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p19/r5.speaker: ابن مهران
NASHR:v2p19/r5.claim: Ibn Mihrān says the shaykhs taught assimilation across readings, except al-Naqqāsh's iẓhār for Nāfiʿ and ʿĀṣim, also reported by al-Bukhārī for Warsh.
NASHR:v2p19/r5.anchor: وكذلك قرأنا على المشايخ في جميع القراءات أعني بالإدغام إلا عن أبي بكر النقاش فإنه كان يأخذ لنافع وعاصم بالإظهار

NASHR:v2p19/r6.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p19/r6.speaker: ابن مهران
NASHR:v2p19/r6.claim: Ibn Mihrān calls a middle reading the right choice for one avoiding assimilation, but says an audible intermediate iẓhār is ugly and unanimously impermissible.
NASHR:v2p19/r6.anchor: وقرأناه بين الإظهار والإدغام قال وهو الحق والصواب لمن أراد ترك الإدغام فأما إظهار بين فقبيح

NASHR:v2p19/r7.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v2p19/r7.speaker: author
NASHR:v2p19/r7.claim: The author accepts retaining the quality of istiʿlāʾ as textually and orally sound, but prefers full assimilation as better transmitted and analogically stronger, especially for Abū ʿAmr's major assimilation.
NASHR:v2p19/r7.anchor: وأما الصفة فليس بغلط ولا قبيح، فقد صح عندنا نصا وأداء

NASHR:v1p299/r1.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p299/r1.speaker: جمهور رواة الإدغام عن أبي عمرو
NASHR:v1p299/r1.claim: Most transmitters who assimilate rāʾ into itself or lām retain imāla of the preceding alif because assimilation is incidental; Ibn Habash reports al-Susi opening it while counting the assimilation.
NASHR:v1p299/r1.anchor: كل من أدغم الراء في مثلها، أو في اللام أبقى إمالة الألف قبلها نحو وقنا عذاب النار ربنا

NASHR:v1p299/r2.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p299/r2.speaker: رواة الإدغام عن أبي عمرو
NASHR:v1p299/r2.claim: All transmitters of Abu Amr agree on complete assimilation of qāf into kāf, removing qāf’s emphatic quality and articulation; the dissent over this word comes from those who do not transmit Abu Amr’s assimilation.
NASHR:v1p299/r2.anchor: أجمع رواة الإدغام، عن أبي عمرو، على إدغام القاف في الكاف إدغاما كاملا يذهب معه صفة الاستعلاء ولفظها

NASHR:v1p299/r3.author: Ibn al-Jazarī
NASHR:v1p299/r3.speaker: رواة الإدغام عن أبي عمرو
NASHR:v1p299/r3.claim: They also unanimously assimilate nūn into lām or rāʾ completely without nasalization, regardless of whether a narrator elsewhere transmits ghunna before lām and rāʾ.
NASHR:v1p299/r3.anchor: وكذلك أجمعوا على إدغام النون في اللام والراء إدغاما خالصا كاملا من غير غنة

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r7.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r7.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r7.claim: The initial human creation is evidence that resurrection is possible; ماء مهين is weak fluid, the semen of man and woman.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p375/r7.anchor: ولما ذكر إفناء الأولين والآخرين، ذكر ووقف على أصل الخلقة التي يقتضي النظر فيها تجويز البعث، من ماء مهين: أي ضعيف هو مني الرجل والمرأة

ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#4/r1.claim: The humble, filthy fluid is a sperm drop.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#4/r1.anchor: من نطفة قذرة مهينة وليس فيه دليل على نجاسة المني

ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#4/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#4/r2.claim: Calling semen lowly or filthy does not establish that it is legally impure.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p174#4/r2.anchor: وليس فيه دليل على نجاسة المني

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r8.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r8.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r8.claim: The lowly fluid is a sperm drop.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p305/r8.anchor: ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين} يعني النطفة.

BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r7.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r7.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:77:17-24/r7.claim: The lowly fluid is a dirty, base drop of semen.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r1.claim: The lowly water is a contemptible, weak, filthy drop.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r1.anchor: أي نطفة مذرة ذليلة , وهو من مهن بالفتح

BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r2.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r2.speaker: القاموس
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r2.claim: Al-Qamus defines mahīn as contemptible, weak, or scant.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r2.anchor: قال في القاموس : والمهين : الحقير الضعيف والقليل

BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r9.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r9.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r9.claim: After citing destruction as evidence of power over resurrection, the author points to initial creation as an even clearer proof.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p285/r9.anchor: ولما ذكر الإهلاك على ذلك الوجه الدال على القدرة التامة على البعث

DURR-FULL:v8p383/r1.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p383/r1.speaker: ابن عباس
DURR-FULL:v8p383/r1.claim: Ibn Abbas glosses mahīn as weak.
DURR-FULL:v8p383/r1.anchor: عن ابن عباس في قوله: {ألم نخلقكم من ماء مهين} يعني بالمهين الضعيف

DURR-FULL:v8p383/r2.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p383/r2.speaker: مجاهد
DURR-FULL:v8p383/r2.claim: Mujahid says the weak fluid is in a secure lodging.
DURR-FULL:v8p383/r2.anchor: عن مجاهد في قوله: {من ماء مهين} قال: ضعيف في قرار مكين

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r7.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r7.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r7.claim: The weak, contemptible water is semen from both male and female.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p418#2/r7.anchor: معناه الضعيف وهو المني من الرجل والمرأة

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r1.speaker: قالون عن نافع
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r1.claim: Qālūn, transmitting from Nāfiʿ, pronounces the qāf distinctly.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r1.anchor: قرأ قالون عن نافع بإظهار القاف

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r2.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r2.speaker: الباقون
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r2.claim: The other reciters assimilate the qāf.

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r3.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r3.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p448#3/r3.claim: The water is described as weak.

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r2.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r2.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r2.claim: The human originates from weak, lowly fluid, insignificant beside the Creator's power; this is an argument for recreating the dead from an initial creation.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r2.anchor: أي: ضعيف حقير بالنسبة إلى قدرة البارئ عز وجل،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r3.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r3.speaker: محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r3.claim: Ibn Kathir recalls the report from Busr ibn Jahhash in Ya-Sin: God challenges Adam's child, asking how he can defy Him after being created from something like this.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p298/r3.anchor: في حديث بسر بن جحاش: "ابن آدم، أنى تعجزني وقد خلقتك من مثل هذه؟ "

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r6.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r6.speaker: ابن عباس
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r6.claim: Mihin water is the pure or selected part of the fluid.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r6.anchor: من صفوة الماء , قاله ابن عباس

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r7.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r7.speaker: مجاهد وقتادة
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r7.claim: Mihin means weak or lowly water.
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r7.anchor: من ماء ضعيف , قاله مجاهد وقتادة

MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r8.author: al-Māwardī
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r8.speaker: ابن كامل
MAWARDI-FULL:v6p177/r8.anchor: من مني سائل , قاله ابن كامل

MUQATIL:77:8-23/r13.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:77:8-23/r13.speaker: author
MUQATIL:77:8-23/r13.claim: The human being is created from weak water, meaning semen; this beginning should make deniers reflect.

NASAFI-FULL:v4p307#14/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p307#14/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p307#14/r1.claim: “ماء مهين” means lowly, referring to semen.

QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r1.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r1.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r1.claim: Māʾ mahīn is a weak, lowly substance, namely the semen drop.

QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r2.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r2.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r2.claim: Qurtubi says this verse is used as proof by those who hold that the embryo comes from the man’s fluid alone.
QURTUBI-FULL:77:20-23/r2.anchor: وهذه الآية أصل لمن قال: إن خلق الجنين
